Replace.Text: 为您的国家增加一枚核装置。射程为10。爆炸半径为1个单元格。摧毁爆炸范围内的一切并生成核辐射。需要30 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] 铀。维护费是100 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

Adds one Nuclear Device to your nation's inventory. Range is 10. The explosion radius is 1 tiles. Destroying everything within range of the explosion and generating nuclear radiation. Requires 30 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] Uranium. Maintenance is 100 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
为您的国家增加一枚热核装置。射程为12。爆炸半径为2个单元格。摧毁爆炸范围内的一切并生成核辐射。需要40 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] 铀。维护费是150 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

Adds a Thermonuclear Device to your nation's inventory. Range is 12. The explosion radius is 2 tiles. Destroying everything within range of the explosion and generating nuclear radiation. Requires 40 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] Uranium. Maintenance is 150 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
完成曼哈顿计划后解锁。允许创建热核装置和核导弹。
Unlock this project upon completion of the Manhattan Project. Allows you to create Thermonuclear Device and Nuclear Missile.
完成常春藤行动后解锁。允许创建氢弹和中子弹。
Unlock this project upon completion of the Operation IVY. Allows you to create Hydrogen Bomb and Neutron bomb.
为您的国家增加一枚氢弹。射程为15。爆炸半径为3个单元格。摧毁爆炸范围内的一切并生成核辐射。需要60 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] 铀。维护费是250 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

Adds a Hydrogen Bomb to your nation's inventory. Range is 15. The explosion radius is 3 tiles. Destroying everything within range of the explosion and generating nuclear radiation. Requires 60 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] Uranium. Maintenance is 250 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
为您的国家增加一枚中子弹。射程为15。爆炸半径为4个单元格。主要用于打击单位和城市人口，不会产生核辐射，不会对改良设施、建筑和区域造成破坏。需要50 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] 铀。维护费是200 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

Adds a Neutron Bomb to your nation's inventory. Range is 15. The explosion radius is 4 tiles. Mainly used to strike units and city populations. It will not produce nuclear radiation and will not cause damage to improvements, buildings and districts. Requires 50 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] Uranium. Maintenance is 200 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
为您的国家增加一枚核导弹。射程范围可覆盖全世界。爆炸半径为1个单元格。摧毁爆炸范围内的一切并生成核辐射。需要40 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] 铀。维护费是150 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

Adds a Nuclear Missile to your nation's inventory. The strike range can cover the whole world. The explosion radius is 1 tiles. Destroying everything within range of the explosion and generating nuclear radiation. Requires 40 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] Uranium. Maintenance is 150 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
为您的国家增加一枚导弹。射程为20。仅打击目标单元格，摧毁目标单元格上的一切。需要30 [ICON_Resource_Aluminum] 铝。维护费是50 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

Adds a Missile to your nation's inventory. Range is 20. Only hit the target tile, destroying everything on that tile. Requires 30 [ICON_Resource_Aluminum] Aluminum. Maintenance is 50 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
